overview_description.description: Gooo Delivery is an on-demand delivery company that provides point-to-point delivery services in several Egyptian cities, including Cairo, Giza, and Tanta, via an app that allows users to order food, medication, and groceries. To protect the rights of all parties, the app connects users with verified independent runners who are supervised by the app.
